entries.desc: Walk the specified PLAN-to-DEV acceptance_topology_check and DEV-to-REVIEW pre_review_check algorithms on a complete example -> the structural check validates graph totality before implementation while the executable check requires current admissible proof before REVIEW, with deterministic pass/warn/block outputs and named failure codes; WHY: proves the two gates own different lifecycle questions.

entries.desc: Evaluate freshness cases where materialHash matches, materialHash drifts while signed storyFilesHash matches, storyFilesHash changes, or legacy records lack storyFilesHash -> the plan preserves strict fallback, mandatory re-attestation advisory, and stale rejection semantics without silent rebinding; WHY: aligns proposed checks with existing freshness truth.

Substitute positive-only evidence, inverted mutation polarity, a transcript unrelated to the asserted claim, or caller-writable authority metadata -> pre_review_check rejects the edge with specific reason codes and cannot promote local or diagnostic output to Authority proof; WHY: prevents proof-shaped but semantically invalid evidence from passing.

evidence.note: Deterministic error codes cover adverse cases.

entries.desc: Remove a required producer-consumer edge or describe a gate fact only in prose -> acceptance_topology_check fails closed and the plan requires CLI/handler enforcement plus process-fact registry and contract-verifier updates for every gate-consumed fact; WHY: prevents prompt-only or partial-graph bypass.
